### 🐛 Describe the bug When serving Kimi K2 base or DeepSeek v3 base, with the default moe_backend selection of FlashInfer TRTLLM will cause hangs under DP/EP. On the other hand, TP with TRTLLM and DP/EP with triton moe_backend work. This issue was not present in 0.20.1. I bisected vLLM releases and found that 0.21.0 introduced this regression; all releases after seem to have this problem. Flashinfer was not bumped between those two versions, still at 0.6.8.post1, so it seems unlikely to be related. I dug into the code changes around the code listed in the py-spy output below, and https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/39917 touches related files, with https://github.com/flashinfer-ai/flashinfer/issues/4172 reading like a possibly related issue. (FP4 hangs under PDL; the suggestion in the issue is to disable PDL) When py-spying the stuck deployment, roughly 10 minutes into a prefill-heavy load (perplexity eval), it looks like flashinfer::trtllm_fp8_block_scale_moe is hung, either around or at execute_dummy_batch. I was unable to verify whether the behavior was crawling or hanging.
